description: Presidential Secretariat - Prorogue Parliament w.e.f. midnight of 12.12.2021 and hereby fix the 18.01.2022 at 10.00 a.m. for the commencement of the next session and summon Parliament to meet in the Chamber of Parliament
reasoning: This gazette content is a proclamation by the President proroguing Parliament and summoning it to meet on a specific future date. This directly relates to parliamentary procedures and the scheduling of legislative sessions, which falls under electoral and parliamentary processes. According to the classification rules, this fits Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with "Election announcements and schedules" and parliamentary summoning is a core function of electoral/parliamentary administration.
